cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. For tonight's courtyard film, you fold the moon; I'll switch off the lamps. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How do I fold the moon?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Start with the crescent. It already has a crease.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll take the lamps. You handle the sky.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll do lamps, chairs and projector if you'll own the moon. Can I tell the audience we're waiting for your blackout?

mechanism: A directs a film setup and accepts more practical jobs to get B to own the impossible moon-folding blackout task.
confusable: Unlike ordinary delegation, A protects the one impossible assignment from B proposed swap.
comparison: Public film preparation and work bargaining differ from physically helping someone bottle time while leaving them the impossible judgment.
seedUse: D149-a courtyard film, moon and practical setup; S02-a pays for cooperation with extra real tasks.
